description: 20 cases for measuring medpsy's ICD-10 coding accuracy. expected_code is the curated, DB-verified WHO ICD-10 answer key; condition is the canonical phrase used to exercise the lookup tool. The script asks medpsy to code each vignette and compares to expected_code.

Lower back pain with new numbness over the inner thighs and buttocks and difficulty starting to urinate.
Sudden 'worst headache of my life' reaching maximum in seconds, with neck stiffness and photophobia.
Pleuritic chest pain and breathlessness two days after a long-haul flight, with a hot swollen calf.
Lip and tongue swelling, widespread urticaria and throat tightening minutes after a first dose of antibiotic.
Young adult with vomiting, marked thirst and polyuria, deep rapid breathing and a fruity breath odour.
Right iliac fossa pain worse on movement, with anorexia and vomiting for a day.
Burning on urination and urinary frequency for one day in a non-pregnant woman, no fever or flank pain.
Sudden right-arm weakness and slurred speech that began one hour ago.
74-year-old with new right temporal headache, scalp tenderness and jaw ache on chewing, with blurred vision.

14-year-old with sudden lower abdominal pain, vomiting and a tender high-riding testicle.

Productive cough with green sputum, fever and focal chest crackles, breathless on exertion.
